name: Tongyu Heavy Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Tongyu Heavy Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of forgings and structural components. It offers wind power generator main shafts, cylinders, gear rings, ductile iron casting pipe molds, cold work rolls, support rolls, steam turbines, cranks, marine shafts, pressure vessel forgings, machine tool, forging blanks, ESR and steel ingots, etc., as well as fabrication products and alloys.
